name: Kinesin-1
note: Processive dimeric walker (Vale 1996; Howard review). Human KIF5B.

name: Kinesin-1 KIF5A
note: Same family as KIF5B. Human KIF5A.

name: Kinesin-1 KIF5C
note: Same family as KIF5B. Human KIF5C.

name: Kinesin-2 KIF3A
note: Heterotrimeric kinesin-2 is processive (Gilbert 2018 review). Human KIF3A.

name: Kinesin-2 KIF17
note: Homodimeric kinesin-2. Human KIF17.

name: Kinesin-3 KIF1A
note: Highly processive (Okada 1995). Human KIF1A.

name: Kinesin-3 KIF1B
note: Kinesin-3 family. Human KIF1B.

name: Kinesin-3 KIF13A
note: Kinesin-3 family. Human KIF13A.

name: Kinesin-3 KIF16B
note: Kinesin-3 family. Human KIF16B.

name: Kinesin-5
note: Slow processive plus-end motor (Valentine 2006). Human KIF11.

name: Kinesin-7 CENP-E
note: Processive kinetochore kinesin. Human CENP-E.

name: Kinesin-8 KIF18A
note: Processive plus-end depolymerase (Mayr 2007). Human KIF18A.

name: Kinesin-8 KIF18B
note: Kinesin-8 family. Human KIF18B.

name: Kinesin-13 KIF2C
note: Non-processive depolymeriser (Hunter 2003). Human KIF2C.

name: Kinesin-13 KIF2A
note: Non-processive depolymeriser, same family as MCAK. Human KIF2A.

name: Cytoplasmic dynein
note: Processive minus-end motor with dynactin (Reck-Peterson 2018). Human DYNC1H1.

name: Dynein intermediate chain
note: Subunit of cytoplasmic dynein; processivity is of the motor complex. UniProt left blank rather than guessed.

name: Axonemal dynein
note: Outer-arm axonemal dynein is processive in vitro (Sakakibara 1999). Human DNAH5.

name: Myosin II skeletal
note: Skeletal myosin II is non-processive (Finer 1994 three-bead assay). Human MYH2. The bare synonym myosin II is this row; cardiac and smooth rows keep their own names.

name: Myosin II cardiac
note: Cardiac beta-myosin is non-processive as a monomer ensemble. Human MYH7.

name: Myosin II smooth
note: Smooth-muscle myosin II. Human MYH11.

name: Myosin II non-muscle
note: Non-muscle myosin IIA. Human MYH9.

name: Myosin II non-muscle B
note: Non-muscle myosin IIB. Human MYH10.

name: Myosin V
note: Processive hand-over-hand walker (Mehta 1999). Human MYO5A.

name: Myosin Va
note: Same accession as Myosin V; synonym row for MYO5A spelling.

name: Myosin VI
note: Processive minus-end myosin when dimeric (Rock 2001). Human MYO6.

name: Myosin VII
note: Dimeric myosin VII is processive (Yang 2006). Human MYO7A.

name: Myosin X
note: Processive on actin bundles (Nagy 2008). Human MYO10.

name: Myosin I
note: Single-headed myosin I is non-processive. Human MYO1A.

name: Myosin Ib
note: Myosin I family. Human MYO1B.

name: E. coli RNAP
synonyms: rpoB|E. coli RNA polymerase|bacterial RNA polymerase
note: Processive transcription (Wang 1998). E. coli rpoB.

name: T7 RNAP
note: Highly processive single-subunit polymerase. Bacteriophage T7.

name: RNA polymerase II
note: Processive elongation complex. Human POLR2A.

name: T7 DNAP
note: Processive with thioredoxin. Bacteriophage T7 gene 5.

name: DNA polymerase I
note: Pol I holoenzyme is processive on short patches. E. coli. Klenow is a separate row.

name: Klenow fragment
note: Klenow is poorly processive relative to the holoenzyme (processive set false). UniProt left blank; the fragment is not a separate entry.

name: Phi29 DNAP
note: Highly processive (Blanco 1989). Bacillus phage phi29.

name: DNA polymerase delta
note: Replicative polymerase. Human POLD1.

name: DNA polymerase epsilon
note: Replicative polymerase. Human POLE.

name: RecBCD
note: Rapid processive helicase/nuclease. E. coli RecB.

name: UvrD
note: Processive 3'-5' helicase. E. coli UvrD.

name: PcrA
note: Processive helicase used in optical-trap studies (Geiselmann; Park 2010). Geobacillus PcrA.

name: Rep helicase
note: Rep processivity depends on dimerisation; left null rather than guessed. E. coli Rep.

name: RecQ
note: Family processivity varies; left null. E. coli RecQ.

name: BLM
note: Processive RecQ-family helicase. Human BLM.

name: WRN
note: Processive RecQ-family helicase. Human WRN.

name: MCM2
note: Replicative helicase subunit; CMG is processive. Human MCM2.

name: MCM4
note: CMG subunit. Human MCM4.

name: CMG helicase
note: CMG is the processive eukaryotic replicative helicase. No single UniProt accession.

name: T7 gp4
note: Processive hexameric helicase. Bacteriophage T7 gp4.

name: DnaB
note: Processive bacterial replicative helicase. E. coli DnaB.

name: FtsK
note: Processive dsDNA translocase (Saleh 2004). E. coli FtsK.

name: SpoIIIE
note: Processive chromosome translocase. B. subtilis SpoIIIE.

name: SMC2
note: Loop-extruding condensin subunit; treated as processive DNA translocase (Ganji 2018). Human SMC2.

name: SMC4
note: Condensin SMC subunit. Human SMC4.

name: SMC1
note: Cohesin can extrude loops; marked processive DNA translocase. Human SMC1A.

name: SMC3
note: Cohesin SMC subunit. Human SMC3.

name: Ribosome
note: Processive translation. No single UniProt accession.

name: Phi29 packaging motor
note: Processive packaging ATPase (Smith 2001). Phage phi29 gp16.

name: T4 terminase
note: Processive large terminase. Phage T4 gp17.

name: Lambda terminase
note: Large terminase subunit. Phage lambda gpA.

name: ClpX
note: Processive unfoldase (Aubin-Tam 2011). E. coli ClpX.

name: ClpA
note: Processive unfoldase. E. coli ClpA.

name: 26S proteasome
note: Processive unfoldase cap. Human PSMC1 stands in for the 19S ATPase.

name: F1-ATPase
note: Rotary, not a linear processive motor (Noji 1997). E. coli atpD beta subunit.

name: Bacterial flagellar motor
note: Rotary. UniProt left blank; the motor is a complex.

name: Viral portal
note: Portal itself is the channel; processivity belongs to the terminase. Marked true only as the packaging-complex label. UniProt left blank.

name: NS3 helicase
note: Processive RNA helicase in single-molecule studies. UniProt left blank (many viral strains).

name: Rho helicase
note: Processive RNA translocase. E. coli Rho.

name: Ribosome EF-G
note: Elongation factor of the processive ribosome, not itself a walker. E. coli fusA. Track is the mRNA.

name: Kinesin-14 Ncd
note: Non-processive minus-end kinesin (Case 1997). UniProt left blank (Drosophila Ncd).

name: Myosin XI
note: Plant myosin XI is processive. UniProt left blank (species-specific).

name: DNA polymerase gamma
note: Mitochondrial replicative polymerase. Human POLG.

name: T7 gp4 primase-helicase
note: Same polypeptide as T7 gp4; synonym for primase-helicase papers.

name: SpaIIIE
note: Spelling variant of SpoIIIE kept so the gazetteer hits both names.

name: AddA
note: Bacillus RecBCD-like helicase; processive. UniProt left blank.

name: TrwB
note: Conjugative DNA translocase. UniProt left blank rather than guessed.
